thread:
Mia Nguyen: Heads-up — scheduling a dedicated-pool "throttle contingency" live test for the reserved ACME-Labs pool this Friday 22:00–23:00 UTC. Objective: validate autoscale behavior + quota fallback (throttle-and-queue) under a surge and exercise rollback. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/reserved-throttle-contingency :rotating_light:
Sam Patel: I can own the load harness. Planning to ramp synthetic traffic 5k -> 80k rps (mix of gen/chat/embeds) and a slower irregular noise to test autoscale hysteresis. Will push script by EOD. :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: I’ll monitor autoscale controllers, GPU utilization, and the KV cache hit metrics. Can wire extra tracepoints. Which load tool?
Mia Nguyen: k6 for generation paths + a small wrk scenario for short chat bursts. Load scripts live in infra/test-suites/contingency. Example k6 snippet:```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.test/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'x'.repeat(512)}), {headers: {'Authorization': 'Bearer $TEST'}});
  sleep(0.05);
}
```
Alex Rivera: I’ll be on-call for fallback/rollback and can flip the fallback policy manually if the queue grows >100s. Add me to the calendar invite. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890
Priya Desai: I notified the ACME PM and they OK'd Friday window but asked we do a short dry-run Thu 20:00 UTC to validate access. Can we do a quick smoke then?
Sam Patel: yep can do Thu smoke (10m). Pushed branch contingency/1765436789 with staged queries. Note: KV prefix caching disabled in the script to simulate cold prefixes.
deploy-bot: Reserved pool capacity check: PASS — pool=acme-reserved-42, GPUs=36, headroom=18%. Maintenance windows clear.
Jordan Lee: Alerts to watch (PromQL): "sum(rate(redwood_requests_total[1m])) by (pool) > 5000" and "avg_over_time(gpu_utilization[5m]) > 0.85". I’ll open temporary alert thresholds and annotate Grafana dashboards.
Mia Nguyen: Timeline plan: Thu 20:00 smoke (10m) -> Fri 22:00 canary (5m) -> 22:05 ramp to full run 22:15–22:45 -> 22:45 cooldown/metrics collection. Roles: Sam=load, Jordan=monitoring, Alex=fallback/rollback, Priya=customer comms. Anyone else?
Alex Rivera: Confirmed. I’ll prepare the rollback play: drain new routing -> re-enable older model shard -> scale down reserved pool by 20%.
Sam Patel: Load script will label requests with header X-test-run:1765436789 and include scenario tags (gen/chat/embed) so we can slice by verb. Also include occasional malformed prompts to test error-paths.
Mia Nguyen: Final checklist before Thu smoke: 1) stop warmers to create realistic cold starts, 2) push temp alert thresholds, 3) set quota cap policy to 'reserve-throttle-80pct' for the run, 4) confirm billing notification. Priya?
Priya Desai: Billing & account ops notified, PM looped. I put the handoff note in the customer playbook.
Jordan Lee: I'll leave a short post-test eval form (link) and automated job to collect sample outputs for quality regression checks.
Mia Nguyen: Perfect. Last call: 2 hours before each window we’ll confirm readiness here. Thanks everyone — see you on Zoom. :rocket:
